profile.name: BACnet MS/TP 多路复用器
profile.description: 用于 BACnet MS/TP（主从/令牌传递）串行总线的通信多路复用组件，负责在总线接口与上层应用之间转发、分发和管理报文。常用于楼宇自动化及实验室集成场景中，对 BACnet 现场控制器、传感器和执行器的总线通信进行接入、调试与测试。
profile.description_en: A communication multiplexer for BACnet MS/TP (Master-Slave/Token-Passing) serial networks. It forwards, distributes, and manages protocol messages between the bus interface and higher-level applications. It is commonly used in building automation and laboratory integration setups for connecting, testing, and debugging BACnet field controllers, sensors, and actuators.
